question: Who became the fastest cricketer to reach 13,000 test runs as of June 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Joe Root**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• As of **June 2025**, the **England** batter **Joe Root** became the fastest cricketer to reach the monumental milestone of **13,000 runs** in **Test cricket**.
 
• Root achieved this feat during a **Test match** against **India**, surpassing previous timing and innings records set by legendary players like **Sachin Tendulkar** and **Sir Alastair Cook**.
 
• By reaching this landmark, **Joe Root** solidified his position as one of the greatest modern-day red-ball cricketers, being a prominent member of the prestigious **"Fab Four"** group of batsmen.
 
• Since making his **debut** in **2012** at **Nagpur**, Root has been a cornerstone of the **England cricket team**, known for his technical proficiency and ability to score across different conditions globally.
